subject.title: fix(agents): prevent recursive task execution during model fallback

question: Should fallback completion-announcement turns retain the ability to spawn genuinely new remaining work, or should OpenClaw intentionally fail closed and forbid all embedded spawns on those turns?
rationale: The incident requires stopping duplicate execution, but the patch's turn-wide denial conflicts with the existing instruction to continue the original task's own remaining steps; repository behavior does not establish which compatibility policy maintainers intend.

options.title: Preserve legitimate spawning
options.body: Narrow the guard to re-execution of announced work while allowing distinct remaining-task delegation.

options.title: Accept fail-closed behavior
options.body: Intentionally forbid all embedded spawning on fallback completion turns and document and prove that compatibility change.

recommendation.title: Preserve legitimate spawning
recommendation.body: Narrow the guard to re-execution of announced work while allowing distinct remaining-task delegation.
